title: CategorizeRequest
description: The full request body of `POST /categorize` — plain JSON. `api` has already run the pgvector retrieval step (POST /embed-query + a nearest-neighbor search); this request carries the extracted expense fields, the org's category taxonomy, and the retrieved chunk texts for `ai` to classify against. `ai` never touches Postgres directly.

total_minor.description: Money as an integer of minor units, same convention as the extraction contract.

categories.description: The organization's category taxonomy — the only names `ai` is allowed to choose from.

policy_chunks.description: Top-k policy chunks retrieved by `api` via pgvector similarity against the expense's embedded description. May be empty if the organization has no policy documents, or no chunk cleared the similarity floor.
